title: Minimum size.
officialText:
Emergency escape and rescue openings shall have a minimum net clear opening of 6 square feet (0.56 m2).
Exception: The minimum net clear opening for emergency escape and rescue grade-floor openings shall be 5 square feet (0.46 m2) unless such opening is required for natural ventilation in accordance with Chapter 12.
